bug_info.bug_desc: In tlul_cmd_intg_chk, err_o was computed so that |data_err was gated by wr_txn. Therefore a_data integrity errors were only reported on PutFullData/PutPartialData write requests; read requests with corrupted data-integrity sidebands were accepted silently. This violates the checker requirement that data integrity is validated for every presented request regardless of read/write. In rv_core_ibex, the instruction TL-UL adapter previously connected wdata_intg_i to a literal all-zero value on its read-only port, which is not the valid prim_secded_inv_39_32_enc() integrity word for the zero a_data payload. Once the checker validates a_data integrity on reads, instruction fetches would be falsely flagged unless the adapter supplies the correct zero-data integrity value.
bug_info.fix_hint: Change the checker's combinational expression so |data_err is included whenever a_valid is asserted, not only when wr_txn is asserted. In rv_core_ibex, generate the correct integrity word for the constant-zero instruction write-data payload with prim_secded_pkg::prim_secded_inv_39_32_enc('0) and drive that onto wdata_intg_i of the instruction tlul_adapter_host instead of the previous all-zero value.
